newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Konsortium Perkapalan in Thai venture.
newsitem.headline: Konsortium Perkapalan in Thai venture.

text.p: Malaysian haulage concern Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd said it had made an agreement to set up a joint venture haulage company in Thailand.
Konsortium said the joint venture with the Wanasooks, a prominent Thai family, will be called KPB Sadao ICD Co Ltd.
No further details were available on the family.

The venture, of which Konsortium will own 40 percent with the balance held by the Thai partner, will operate an inland container depot along with haulage and related services in Thailand. Its proposed authorised capital is 60 million baht.
Konsortium said the venture has applied to the Thai authorities for an inland port license.
